lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਰਖਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਚੁਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)khee birakh suhaavaRaa sach chugai gur bhaai ||
lines.translation: The soul-bird in the beautiful tree of the body pecks at Truth, with love for the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਉਡੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras peevai sahaj rahai udai na aavai jaai ||
lines.translation: She drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and abides in intuitive ease; she does not fly around coming and going.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa paaiaa har har naam samaai ||1||
lines.translation: She obtains her home within her own heart; she is absorbed into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re gur kee kaar kamaai ||
lines.translation: O mind, work to serve the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhaanai je chalahi taa anadin raachahi har naai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: If you walk in harmony with the Guru's Will, you shall remain immersed in the Lord's Name, night and day. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਰਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੇ ਊਡਹਿ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)khee birakh suhaavaRe oodahi chahu dis jaahi ||
lines.translation: The birds in the beautiful trees fly around in all four directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਊਡਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇ ਨਿਤ ਦਾਝਹਿ ਤੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jetaa oodahi dukh ghane nit daajhahi tai bilalaahi ||
lines.translation: The more they fly around, the more they suffer; they burn and cry out in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur mahal na jaapaee naa a(n)mrit phal paahi ||2||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, they do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and they do not obtain the Ambrosial Fruit. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh braham hareeaavalaa saachai sahaj subhaai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is like God's tree, always green, blessed with the Sublime Love of the True One, with intuitive peace and poise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਖਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakhaa teen nivaareeaa ek sabad liv laai ||
lines.translation: He cuts off the three branches of the three qualities, and embraces love for the One Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਖਵਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit phal har ek hai aape dei khavaai ||3||
lines.translation: The Lord alone is the Ambrosial Fruit; He Himself gives it to us to eat. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਊਭੇ ਸੁਕਿ ਗਏ ਨਾ ਫਲੁ ਤਿੰਨਾ ਛਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh oobhe suk gae naa phal ti(n)naa chhaau ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs stand there and dry up; they do not bear any fruit, and they do not provide any shade.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿੰਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ਨ ਬੈਸੀਐ ਓਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਨ ਗਿਰਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ti(n)naa paas na baiseeai onaa ghar na giraau ||
lines.translation: Don't even bother to sit near them-they have no home or village.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਤੈ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kateeahi tai nit jaaleeahi onaa sabad na naau ||4||
lines.translation: They are cut down and burnt each day; they have neither the Shabad, nor the Lord's Name. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukame karam kamaavane paiai kirat phiraau ||
lines.translation: According to the Lord's Command, people perform their actions; they wander around, driven by the karma of their past actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਾ ਜਹ ਭੇਜਹਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukame darasan dekhanaa jah bhejahi tah jaau ||
lines.translation: By the Lord's Command, they behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Wherever He sends them, there they go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: hukame har har man vasai hukame sach samaau ||5||
lines.translation: By His Command, the Lord, Har, Har, abides within our minds; by His Command we merge in Truth. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam na jaanahi bapuRe bhoole phirahi gavaar ||
lines.translation: The wretched fools do not know the Lord's Will; they wander around making mistakes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: manahath karam kamaavade nit nit hohi khuaar ||
lines.translation: They go about their business stubborn-mindedly; they are disgraced forever and ever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar saa(n)t na aavaee naa sach lagai piaar ||6||
lines.translation: Inner peace does not come to them; they do not embrace love for the True Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ ਮੁਹ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukheeaa muh sohane gur kai het piaar ||
lines.translation: Beautiful are the faces of the Gurmukhs, who bear love and affection for the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee bhagatee sach rate dar sachai sachiaar ||
lines.translation: Through true devotional worship, they are attuned to Truth; at the True Door, they are found to be true.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਕਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: aae se paravaan hai sabh kul kaa karahi udhaar ||7||
lines.translation: Blessed is their coming into being; they redeem all their ancestors. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh nadaree karam kamaavade nadaree baahar na koi ||
lines.translation: All do their deeds under the Lord's Glance of Grace; no one is beyond His Vision.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisee nadar kar dekhai sachaa taisaa hee ko hoi ||
lines.translation: According to the Glance of Grace with which the True Lord beholds us, so do we become.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vadaaeeaa karam paraapat hoi ||8||3||20||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Glorious Greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is received only by His Mercy. ||8||3||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaaeeai manamukh boojh na paai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sadaa mukh oojale har vasiaa man aai ||
lines.translation: The faces of the Gurmukhs are always radiant; the Lord has come to dwell within their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje hee sukh paaeeai sahaje rahai samaai ||1||
lines.translation: Through intuitive understanding they are at peace, and through intuitive understanding they remain absorbed in the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaaee re daasan daasaa hoi ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, be the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee sevaa gur bhagat hai viralaa paae koi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Service to the Guru is worship of the Guru. How rare are those who obtain it! ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa suhaag suhaaganee je chalahi satigur bhaai ||
lines.translation: The happy soul-bride is always with her Husband Lord, if she walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa pir nihachal paaeeai naa ohu marai na jaai ||
lines.translation: She attains her Eternal, Ever-stable Husband, who never dies or goes away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabad milee naa veechhuRai pir kai a(n)k samaai ||2||
lines.translation: United with the Word of the Shabad, she shall not be separated again. She is immersed in the Lap of her Beloved. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਜਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har niramal at oojalaa bin gur paaiaa na jaai ||
lines.translation: The Lord is Immaculate and Radiantly Bright; without the Guru, He cannot be found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜੈ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਈ ਭੇਖੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paath paRai naa boojhaee bhekhee bharam bhulaai ||
lines.translation: He cannot be understood by reading scriptures; the deceitful pretenders are deluded by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee har sadaa paaiaa rasanaa har ras samaai ||3||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is always found, and the tongue is permeated with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu chukaaiaa guramatee sahaj subhaai ||
lines.translation: Emotional attachment to Maya is shed with intuitive ease, through the Guru's Teachings.
